Name: Crop Watering Bubbles Continued
Author: temisthem
Description:
Updated [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17773?tab=description]Crop Watering Bubbles[/url] by aedenthorn to be 1.6 compatible.
New features:
[list]
[*]Config allows for bubbles to always be shown instead of appearing at intervals + other config options
[*]Works with garden pots
[/list]
[size=6][b]Multiplayer Compatibility:[/b][/size]

Only makes client-side changes, so it will only affect those who have it installed.

[b][size=6]Source Code:[/size][/b]

If you want to help make this mod better, or maybe you think my code sucks and you can do better, visit my repo [url=https://github.com/temisthem/StardewValleyMods]here[/url]

[b][size=6]Permissions Disclaimer:[/size][/b]

Aedenthorn returned and updated a lot of their mods, but I've made a decent bit of my own changes and rewrote enough of the code that I'd like to continue maintaining it. If you'd like to support Aedenthorn, the original author, then go ahead and use theirs. If there's a change that you particularly enjoyed in this version of the mod, you can keep using this. Cheers!

[s]Aedenthorn has retired from SDV modding and has removed all restrictions on permissions concerning their mods.
This announcement can be found [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/156109690059751424/1194051284177801307]here[/url] in the Stardew Valley Modding Discord server.[/s]

Aedenthorn's [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]Stardew Valley Mod repo[/url] uses the GPL-3 license which allows derivative works to be allowed without requiring permission, given that they remain free, open source, and also use the same GPL-3 license.

[b][size=6]Original Description:[/size][/b]

With this mod installed, crops that are unwatered will show a water drop emote at a set interval (default 3 seconds), or on key press (disabled by default).

You can change the interval, whether to require a key press instead, and the opacity and size of the emote in the config.

You can also set an option to only activate the mod when the farmer is holding a watering can.


[b][size=5]Config[/size][/b]

You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[b][size=5]Technical[/size][/b]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].

﻿﻿If you want to complain or ask for help or help me test my mods, you can visit [url=https://discord.gg/bs6zHuj]my Discord server﻿[/url].

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
